title: semi-permeable membrane: tending to your psychic skin
content:
artifacts are metaphorical-poetic teachings for navigating the creative life, released weekly as a part of labyrinth library.

this artifact is available, in its entirety, as a public offering.

explore semi-permeable membrane

I’ve been in desperate need of this artifact my entire life — without realizing it. for years, I’ve always felt burdened by how sensitive I am. and, perhaps sensitive is the wrong word — in our world, sensitivity implies a sense of fragility. I feel things deeply and for a very long time, and blamed myself for being so easily thrown off center. I felt shame for being a psychic sponge; easily disrupted by the energies of other people, and my environment. of course, this too, is a superpower. we just need training to work with it.

how does this “problem” manifest? it takes me days, if not weeks, to discharge and metabolize what I experience in the outside world. this is why, for years, I was so obsessed with inner world & wellbeing practices. I’ve grappled with needing to do rigorous work to take care of my psychic-creative immune system.

when I’m overwhelmed, my mind eats itself. it first becomes a soggy sponge, then a carnivorous flower, then, a blue screen of death. I have anxiety spirals. the older I get, the more I feel acutely that psychic spaciousness is not nice to have; it’s essential.

*

this artifact is about working deliberately with porous boundaries of the self — how embracing the nature of its semi-permeability can help us transform our relationship with it. I also explore the membrane of a single creative project or practice — how to give fluid shape to raw substance.

because of how essential I think this work is, I’ve made it a public offering.

you can work with it here.

there’s also 2 guided visualizations included.

*
Purpose: tending to your psychic skin — working with your sensitivity as a creative power. sensing what you absorb, what you filter, and how you give shape and form to raw substance.

Guiding Question: how does your membrane work? what are you allowing in, and what are you filtering out?

Astrological Season: Pisces
Trail-marker Word: Shaping
